title: Primary & secondary schools in Tinsukia start at 8am as heatwave persist - The Times of India
full_text:
Primary & secondary schools in Tinsukia start at 8am as heatwave persist
“In view of the scorching heat prevailing in the district, it has been deemed necessary to modify the school timing, considering the health and safety of the students,” the inspector of schools said in the order.
The order also prescribes a standard operating procedure, directing schools to hold morning assemblies in shaded areas, encourage students to carry water bottles and drink water frequently, and exempt them from wearing socks, shoes and neckties.
Schools have also been instructed to ensure immediate medical attention for heat-affected students, keep ceiling fans functional and electrical fittings safe, prioritise cleaning of toilets and urinals, and arrange classroom seating to ensure proper ventilation.
